events.name: Shell Game
events.intro: "Follow the Poké Ball, friend! Guess right and your money doubles."

success.text: Under the middle shell! Double your money.

failure.text: Empty. The dealer grins.

success.text: You never lost sight of the ball. Double your money.

failure.text: You blinked. The ball is gone.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Whack-a-Diglett
events.intro: A fairground mallet and a lot of holes. "Tap before they hide! Points pay cash."

success.text: Whack! A perfect round. The stall pays out.

failure.text: They hide faster than you swing. A small prize.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pachinko Arcade
events.intro: Rows of pins and a hundred tiny pockets. "Drop a ball. Pockets have prizes."

success.text: The ball drops into the top pocket! Prize tray full.

failure.text: It bounces out. Nothing.

choices.label: Drop a Poké Ball by hand

success.text: You aim it straight into the glowing pocket.

failure.text: It rattles off the pins. A token prize.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Claw Machine
events.intro: A glass box of Poké Dolls and shiny prizes. The claw hovers, waiting.

success.text: The claw closes on a rare prize and holds!

failure.text: It drops the prize halfway. You win a Poké Doll.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Hot Potato Duel
events.intro: "Hold the Voltorb when it hits zero and it blows. Pass it fast!"

success.text: Perfect timing! He is left holding the bag. He pays up.

failure.text: Boom! Static everywhere.

success.text: Your Electric-type happily eats the charge. The man is stunned and pays.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Treasure Map Sudoku
events.intro: A torn map made of nine squares, each marked with symbols. Every row and column must hold each symbol once.

success.text: Click. The last symbol fits and the map points to a chest.

failure.text: The squares will not fit. You tear the corner.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rune Tiles
events.intro: A sealed stone door with sliding rune tiles and one empty space.

success.text: The runes line up and the door grinds open on a small vault.

failure.text: The tiles jam. A dart trap nicks you.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Whistle Echo Quiz
events.intro: "Copy my melody exactly and the prize is yours," he says, and whistles four notes.

success.text: Note for note. He claps and hands over a prize.

failure.text: Off-key. He laughs and gives you a small thank-you.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Weather Forecast Bet
events.intro: "Will the next node be rainy or clear? ₽200 says you cannot tell."

success.text: Not a cloud turned back. You win.

failure.text: Bright sun. He collects.

success.text: Your read of the clouds was dead right.

failure.text: The wind changed on you.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Odd One Out
events.intro: Six Pokémon silhouettes on a board. "One is an imposter. Which?"

success.text: The imposter had a tiny wrong ear. He pays and you learn something.

failure.text: You guess wrong. He tips his hat.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Silhouette Quiz
events.intro: "Who's that Pokémon?" A dark shape on a screen. Get three in a row for a bonus.

success.text: Correct! The next silhouette appears.

failure.text: Wrong. The screen goes dark.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Silhouette Quiz: Second Shape
events.intro: A bigger shadow. "Streak of one. Keep going."

success.text: Correct again!

failure.text: Wrong. The streak ends, but you keep your winnings.

events.name: Silhouette Quiz: Final Shape
events.intro: "Last one for the streak bonus." A familiar outline, almost.

success.text: Three in a row! The streak bonus is yours.

failure.text: So close. A consolation prize.

events.name: Move Trivia
events.intro: "Match each move to its type, three right in a row for a TM. Question one: Surf is what type?"

success.text: Right. Question two waits.
Wrong. She smiles and hands you a coin.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Move Trivia: Question Two
events.intro: "Question two: Shadow Ball is what type?"

success.text: Right again. Question three.
Wrong. She gives a sympathetic nod.

events.name: Move Trivia: Final Question
events.intro: "Last question: Earthquake is what type?"

success.text: Three in a row! A TM from the shelf is yours.
Close, but no TM. She gives a Super Potion.

events.name: Berry Taste Test
events.intro: Five berries on a tray. "Spicy, dry, sweet, bitter, sour. Pick the one that matches the clue."

success.text: You nail the flavor. She lets you keep a handful.

failure.text: Bitter! You pull a face.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Speed Typing Terminal
events.intro: An old terminal blinks: "TYPE THE LINE BEFORE THE TIMER ENDS."

success.text: ACCESS GRANTED. The terminal coughs up credits.

failure.text: TIMEOUT. The screen shocks your fingers.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pokéathlon Hurdles
events.intro: A short track with six hurdles. "Tap the rhythm and clear them all!"

success.text: Clean run! The crowd cheers.

failure.text: You clip a hurdle. Still a decent run.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Tide Gauge
events.intro: A lock gate and a dial. The water must be exactly level before the gate opens.

success.text: The gate swings open on a stash left by the tide.

failure.text: Too high. Water sloshes over you.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Gear Box Puzzle
events.intro: A drawbridge is stuck. A box of mismatched gears sits beside the crank.

success.text: The gears mesh and the bridge lowers. A grateful engineer pays you.

failure.text: The gears jam. You pry them out and lose time.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lighthouse Mirror Puzzle
events.intro: A dark lighthouse and three loose mirrors. "Beam the light to the shore and the keeper will reward you."

success.text: The beam crosses the bay. A ship signals back with thanks.

failure.text: The beam hits the cliff. The keeper shrugs kindly.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rock Paper Scissors Trainer
events.intro: "Fire, Water or Grass? I always pick Grass! Beat me with your Pokémon's type!"

success.text: Fire beats Grass! He pays out.
You throw Fire by luck. It works!

failure.text: You throw Water. He grins and wins.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Mole Hunt
events.intro: Three burrows. One holds a prize, the others a very annoyed Diglett.

success.text: A shiny prize!

failure.text: A Diglett bites your sleeve.

choices.label: Let your Ground-type sniff it out

success.text: Your Ground-type digs straight to the prize.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Tilt Maze
events.intro: An Electrode sits at the start of a wooden maze. Tilt the board and roll it to the goal.

success.text: Straight into the goal. The Electrode glows happily.

failure.text: It rolls into a hole and sulks.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bobbing for Berries
events.intro: A big tub of water with berries bobbing in it. Hands behind your back!

success.text: Got one! A handful of berries for the effort.

failure.text: Just water up your nose.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Crossword Cave
events.intro: Carved clues line the cave walls, each with empty squares. "Eight letters: a long-dead guardian."

success.text: The last letters light up and a hidden room opens.

failure.text: The carvings stay dark.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Crossword Cave: The Hidden Room
events.intro: A hidden room behind the wall, full of long-forgotten things.

success.text: You pocket a relic.
Inside: a TM and a note of thanks from someone long gone.

events.name: Echo Cave Sonar Puzzle
events.intro: Pitch black. Pings echo off the walls. Follow them to the gap.

success.text: You find the gap and slip through into a shortcut.

failure.text: You bump into a wall. A bat flaps away.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Weighted Scales
events.intro: Four identical gems and a balance scale. "One is real. Weigh them in only two tries."

success.text: The heavy one is the real one. He lets you keep it.

failure.text: You pick a fake. He keeps the real one.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Lantern Riddle
events.intro: Three doors lit by three lanterns. "The truth is behind the door whose lantern does not lie."

success.text: Behind the right door waits a small cache.

failure.text: Behind the wrong door: a Gastly prank.

success.text: Lucky! A cache.

failure.text: A Gastly prank.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Treasure Hunt Bingo
events.intro: "Tick off events on this bingo card as you travel. Fill it for a prize." He hands you a card and tickles one square.

success.text: One square ticked. The card goes in your pocket.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Treasure Hunt Bingo: Second Square
events.intro: You have ticked three squares so far. Another stand marks one more.

success.text: Four squares. One more for a line.

events.name: Treasure Hunt Bingo: Bingo!
events.intro: The last square! "Bingo!" the organizer yells.

success.text: A line! A treasure bundle for the winner.

events.name: Barrel Roll Race
events.intro: A barrel race down a steep slope. Your Pokémon pushes yours to the finish.

success.text: First across the line! Prize money.

failure.text: The barrel veers into a puddle. Last place.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Disco Floor Puzzle
events.intro: A glowing disco floor. Step only on the tiles that light up on the beat.

success.text: Every step lands. The floor lights up and your party dances along.

failure.text: You step on a dead tile. Everyone laughs, you included.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Painting Alignment
events.intro: Four paintings hang crooked on the wall. Rotate them right to reveal the hidden stash.

success.text: The frames click into place and the wall slides open.

failure.text: The wall stays shut. The painter apologizes.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Sandcastle Contest
events.intro: Build the tallest sandcastle. The judge is a Sandygast, and it takes this very seriously.

success.text: Tallest tower on the beach! The Sandygast crowns you.

failure.text: The tower tumbles. The Sandygast pats it flat anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Balloon Pop Challenge
events.intro: "Pop only the matching colors!" A rack of bobbing balloons.

success.text: Clean sweep. A prize tray.

failure.text: You pop a wrong one. Everyone groans.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Balancing Act
events.intro: A tightrope and a stack of party Pokémon. "Hold steady and we all win!"

success.text: The whole team stands like a tower. The crowd roars.

failure.text: The stack wobbles and falls into a haystack. Everyone laughs.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Cupid's Arrow Game
events.intro: A carnival stall: aim hearts at pairs of cut-out Pokémon. "Hit a pair, and your party gets closer!"

success.text: A perfect pair! Your party gets a little closer.

failure.text: A miss. Your party giggles anyway.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Rhythm Raid
events.intro: A street rapper hands you the mic. "Tap along and the beat will carry you into battle."

success.text: The beat locks in. Your party feels fired up for the next battles.

failure.text: You lose the beat but get applause.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Pinball Pokémon Center
events.intro: A giant pinball table in the corner of a Pokémon Center. Bounce the Voltorb for score bonuses.

success.text: High score! Free healing on the house.

failure.text: Tilt! The machine buzzes.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Haunted Jenga
events.intro: A wobbly tower of blocks. Ghosts nudge it every time you reach.

success.text: The tower holds! The ghosts applaud and leave a gift.

failure.text: Crash! The tower falls on your foot.

success.text: Your Ghost-type convinces the ghosts to leave the tower alone.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Slide Whistle Safe
events.intro: A safe that opens only to the right pitch. A slide whistle dangles from the handle.

success.text: Click! The safe opens.

failure.text: Wrong pitch. The alarm rings and a guard rushes in.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Fossil Puzzle
events.intro: A heap of bones. "Assemble the skeleton and the Fossil Lab will revive it for you."

success.text: A full skeleton! The lab hands you the matching fossil.

failure.text: A few bones left over, none of them fit.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Star Chart
events.intro: A planetarium dome with a star chart. Match the constellations to open it.

success.text: The dome opens under a star-filled sky. A map of the road ahead.

failure.text: The chart stays dark.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Crane Operator
events.intro: A harbor crane and a ship waiting for cargo. Speed or accuracy, you decide.

success.text: Every crate lands in place. Dock pay for you.

failure.text: A crate swings loose. The foreman is not impressed.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Smell Test
events.intro: Blindfolded and sniffing a row of jars. "Which item is in this one?"

success.text: Spot on! A potent herb wafts up from the winner's jar.

failure.text: You can only smell your own socks.

success.text: Your Poison-type sniffs it out at once.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Jigsaw Legend
events.intro: A thousand pieces that make a portrait of a legendary Pokémon.

success.text: The portrait completes. A hint about what waits ahead.

failure.text: A few pieces missing. You can still see a silhouette.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Bumper Cars
events.intro: A rink of bumper cars. Knock your rivals off the floor!

success.text: Everyone bounces out! Winner of the rink.

failure.text: You spin out. A rival clips you.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Tug of War
events.intro: Your team on one end of the rope, a group of Machamp on the other.

success.text: The Machamp skid into the mud. The crowd goes wild.

failure.text: The rope burns through your hands. A fair fight.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Carnival Ring Toss
events.intro: A plush Pokémon on a stand. Ring it and your party gets a lucky charm.

success.text: Ringer! A plush that gives your party a little spring in their step.

failure.text: The ring bounces off. A sticker for trying.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.
